description.zh: 服务端生成的一串字符串，作为客户端进行请求的一个标识。
description.en: A string generated by the server that serves as a request identifier for the client.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 发送报告到邮箱和站内信
description.en: Specifies whether to send reports to email and internal messages.

description.zh:
App使用报告发送间隔，可选
- Weekly
- Biweekly
- Monthly
description.en:
The send interval of the app usage report. Valid values:
- Weekly
- Biweekly
- Monthly.

description.zh:
App使用报告订阅状态，可选：

- UnSubscribe
- Subscribe
description.en:
The subscription status of the app usage report. Valid values:

- UnSubscribe
- Subscribe.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs modify-app --app-name App1 --app-tags TagKey=key TagValue=value --subscribe-status Subscribe --subscribe-period Weekly --description This_is_description. --report-send-enabled true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --owner dev789 --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --app-id app-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs ModifyApp --region cn-hangzhou --AppTags.1.TagValue value --Owner dev789 --Description 'This_is_description.' --SubscribeStatus Subscribe --AppId 'app-xxx' --SubscribePeriod Weekly --AppTags.1.TagKey key --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000' --ReportSendEnabled true --AppName App1
